description:
List products currently on promotion at a given supermarket.

    Returns offer label (e.g. "3 for €5", "SAVE €0.75"), was-price,
    validity window, offer_ends (the last day the offer applies, Irish
    time), and where applicable Tesco Clubcard prices,
    SuperValu Real Rewards prices, Dunnes member offers or Lidl Plus prices
    (scan the Lidl Plus app at the till).

    Args:
        store: one of "tesco", "supervalu", "dunnes", "lidl". (Aldi doesn't
            publish multibuy promos so isn't supported here.)
        limit: how many promotional rows to return (default 25).
name: get_promotions

offer_ends.description: Last day the offer applies, YYYY-MM-DD, Irish time, where the retailer states it
offer_ends.title: Offer Ends

offer_valid.description: Validity window in the retailer's own wording
offer_valid.title: Offer Valid

title: Current promotions at a supermarket
